analogy.rationale: Sulfonylureas inhibit ATP-sensitive potassium channels (ABCC8/KCNJ11) and can act as insulin secretagogues, so ATP channel blockers and potassium channel modulators should share the closest transcriptional signature; PPAR agonism is a weaker secondary target. In these cell lines, KATP channel and PPAR expression is low, so the overall response should be weak.
